summary.text: Madison Cook is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Michael Nicholson; there is no incumbent in the race.
She is a member of the Regional School Unit 71 school board in Maine, representing Belfast.

paragraphs.text: Madison Cook assumed office on the Regional School Unit 71 school board in 2025, representing Belfast, and her current term ends in 2028.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for Maine House District 39 on June 9, 2026.
